## What will fight you

Double-sided part: teeth and notch on one face, cam boss on the other. Cam thin-side wall is 1.90 mm; the notch kerf is 0.4 mm (slitting saw, fragile crests). **Every one of the twenty must be co-phased +Y** — scattered phasing is not recoverable at assembly.
